title: MRL controller-built ClaudeCheckpoint factual envelope
description: Guards the controller-observed factual/provenance envelope of the ClaudeCheckpoint the controller builds from an untrusted WorkerResult (D-024-R501/R503). Every field here is filled by the controller from its own run/task/session/Git view; the worker supplies only summary and proposed_next_action. additionalProperties is true because ClaudeCheckpoint also carries those two untrusted text fields and optional controller lists (claims, tests, ci, ...). This is a controller-side guard that the factual envelope was actually populated with well-formed values, in addition to ClaudeCheckpoint.validate().
